patent_grounding.rationale: Revision 2's modeled base/top jaw, complementary mating, rectilinear plug-in, depth-limiting engaging surfaces, wedge angle requirement, clamping function, and jaw exchange behavior are supported by the cited patent text. The revised system/model descriptions explicitly scope out the optional retention variants. No clear fabricated patent fact found.

functional_completeness.rationale: For the stated scoped model, the central jaw connection and disclosed exchange interaction, plus clamping function, are represented. Omission of locking bolt and spring-loaded inhibiting variants is now explicitly bounded rather than silently implied as covered.

flow_consistency.rationale: The prior disconnected-flow issue is repaired: F_JOIN is associated with compatible inout mechanical_linear jaw ports and a jaw-to-jaw interface; F_EXCHANGE is associated with compatible inout mechanical_motion ports and an exchange-device/top-jaw interface. The unsupported standalone clamping-force flow is removed; clamping remains a function without asserting a separate force flow.

claim_traceability.rationale: REQ_ANGLE remains tied to claims 1 and description and allocated to the two jaws; action descriptions and exchange behavior have relevant passage citations. Flow and port/interface citations match their represented motion interactions.

interfaces.rationale: Existing interfaces refer to existing subsystem IDs and port IDs, connect matching flow types, and record each connection once. WORKPIECE is explicitly external and no unsupported workpiece flow/interface is asserted.

textbook_application.rationale: Textbook material is used only as general modeling guidance. Physical components, function entries, scoped external context, and connected flows are reasonable modeling choices; no textbook material is used to support invention facts or add unsupported latch states.

summary: Independent review of revision 2 finds the prior flow-connectivity and scope-clarification issues repaired. The two remaining item flows each have compatible connected ports/interfaces; the unsupported clamping-force flow was removed while retaining the disclosed clamp function. The model explicitly excludes optional locking-bolt and spring-loaded inhibiting variants. Cited patent passages support the modeled content and structure appears coherent on inspection; no unresolved actionable issue identified. Native SysML/schema validation was not independently exposed in the review context, so this review does not attest to a separate validator run.
